_comment: The benchmark environment this commit expects (docs/adr/0018). manifest_sha256 is the pin (sha256 of the canonical environment manifest) of the full environment: the shared image container/benchmark.Dockerfile builds, plus the Win32 corpus's set added on each machine by container/licence.Dockerfile with Microsoft's licence accepted there. A benchmark run in any other environment gets its own run id (-env<hash>). shared_manifest_sha256 is the pin of the shared, licence-free image alone, and shared_image that image by digest. tools_image is its 'tools' stage (where compile databases are built) by digest, and tools_stage that stage's pin, which the shared image's manifest records. Where the images are pulled from is the deployment's business, not this file's. Update all five in the same commit as any change to the Dockerfiles, a dependency set or the manifest generator, after rebuilding (docs/benchmark-setup.rst, "When the image changes"); python -m bench.environment declared FIELD checks them.
